answer: Cap grading capacity like a wharf: each epoch the chain admits only 300 graded tasks, each identity may submit at most 3, and each submission locks a 15 POA bond. A task scores 2 or higher to refund the bond and earn weight; below 2 forfeits the bond. Ten fakes need 30 submissions competing for the same scarce dock, so they queue behind honest agents like a glacier while their bonds bleed on failed work, and one operator cannot buy extra slots. The chain verifies submission caps, bonds, scores, and queue order from public records, so an ocean of clones still faces one narrow harbour.
